allowed_candidate_context: frozen event date and event anchor time
candidate location descriptors derived independently from geography/cartography solely for identity resolution

event_window.freeze_basis: Use the full local calendar day containing the preregistered 14:30 event anchor. This conservative day-level window is frozen before candidate outcome evidence is read and may not be shortened, shifted, or candidate-specific.

requires: at least one independent source with affirmative evidence that the frozen candidate drainage did not activate during the frozen event window
source publication/observation date or explicit temporal coverage
spatial linkage to the exact frozen candidate catchment or an independently resolved drainage identity
reviewer rationale explaining why the evidence is affirmative rather than silence
forbidden_as_sufficient_evidence: candidate absent from a non-exhaustive incident list
candidate absent from a map whose coverage/completeness is not explicitly established

requires: at least one independent source affirmatively documenting activation/flow/overflow/debris-flow response in the frozen candidate drainage during the frozen event window
temporal linkage to the frozen event window
spatial linkage to the exact frozen candidate catchment or independently resolved drainage identity

required_when: sources conflict without a defensible resolution
only inferential or non-independent evidence is available

preferred: contemporaneous or retrospective institutional field/inspection records
official emergency/municipal/technical records with explicit spatial and temporal coverage
peer-reviewed or institutional studies with explicit event observations
georeferenced remote-sensing or imagery interpretation produced independently of IRFEN predictors and target labels
not_independent: A6680 target-outcome narrative used as a target label source

minimum_sufficiency_for_next_gate.note: One affirmative control is the minimum to permit a separate explicit unblind decision record; it is not sufficient to estimate false-alarm rate or production performance.
